versions.subject: Rule to detect the use of the SCX RunAsProvider Invoke_ExecuteShellCommand to execute any UNIX/Linux command using the /bin/sh shell
versions.detection:
selection:
    type: 'SYSCALL'
    SYSCALL: 'execve'
    uid: '0'
    cwd: '/var/opt/microsoft/scx/tmp'
    comm: 'sh'
condition: selection
